newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks flat in quiet London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks flat in quiet London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were steady to marginally weaker on Wednesday, in quiet trading dampened by the lower close in Hong Kong, traders said.

"The market was treading water ahead of (U.S.) CPI but that had very little impact and was much as expected. We might see a little more profit-taking later if Wall Street comes in weaker," one trader said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up two points at 12,938.18 points by 1322 GMT.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index ended 0.76 percent lower at 12,396.18 points after profit-taking pulled the market off an intraday-record of 12,602.34 points.
U.S. consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in September from a month earlier, in line with expectations.
